releaseNotes: v1.4.0: custom providers (persistent, /provider manage), step-by-step UI with /verbose toggle, dangerous-action permission policy (Always Ask/Allow/Deny) with explicit confirmation, filesystem tools (list_dir/read_file/write_file atomic/delete_file) gated by permissions, folder-tree summary in system prompt, ESC-to-cancel with AbortController + shell kill, locked base system prompt vs user custom instructions (/instructions edit, /system-prompt read-only), install.sh self-delete after success, version-info.json added.
